name: sglang
relevance: Official baseline and integration; unquant.py and muse_spark.py; Hopper GEMV and router kernels inspected.
upstream_claim: Official API aggregate 4830.8 us; upstream Hopper GEMV comments claim bandwidth. Neither reproduced here.
caveats: Official pin; optional backends differ from default.

name: triton
relevance: Direct implementation API; tiled dot, masks, persistent scheduling.
upstream_claim: Tutorials 03-matrix-multiplication.py and 09-persistent-matmul.py include benchmark methods; no transferred speed claim.
caveats: Hopper compatible generally; newest checkout differs from image compiler.

name: cutlass
upstream_claim: README Performance charts compare selected GEMMs to peaks; not skinny challenge measurements.
caveats: Do not use Blackwell/Rubin-only kernels on H200.

name: ThunderKittens
relevance: Educational Hopper BF16 GEMM and warpgroup scheduling.
upstream_claim: README claims ~855 TFLOP/s H100 (86% theoretical) for its example; not verified here.
caveats: Large throughput GEMMs do not predict cold-weight M=1 performance.

name: quack
relevance: Hopper GEMM+epilogue and memory-bound kernel design.
upstream_claim: README links single-row BF16 chart and media/2025-07-10-membound-sol.md; no numeric claim transferred.
caveats: Requires new CUDA/CuTe versions; image pins quack 0.6.5, checkout differs.

name: DeepGEMM
relevance: SM90 tensor-core/GEMM design; future grouped-MoE study.
upstream_claim: README reports up to 1550 TFLOP/s H800 for historical FP8 work; not BF16 H200 evidence.
caveats: FP8 conversion is prohibited for this BF16 projection problem.

name: sglang-DeepGEMM
relevance: Exact custom dependency source named by pinned Muse Dockerfile.
upstream_claim: No applicable H200 challenge benchmark reproduced.
caveats: Source clone only; SGLang patch helper not applied/build not run; MoE not this projection.

name: tilelang
relevance: Alternative GEMM DSL, scheduling/autotuning and H100 examples.
upstream_claim: README benchmark summary includes H100 matmul/attention plots; workload-specific upstream claims.
caveats: Newest API may not match installed image; BF16 path only for chosen task.

name: flashinfer
relevance: Inference GEMM/MoE/attention backends and serving integration.
upstream_claim: README explicitly supports H100/H200 SM90; performance descriptions/benchmarks are upstream, not local results.
caveats: Attention kernels are more relevant to separate muse_attention_decode task.

name: flash-attention
license: BSD-3-Clause; cute subtree has separate LICENSE
relevance: Hopper FA3 and future attention task.
upstream_claim: README includes FA3 H100 80GB SXM5 FP16 forward speedup chart; not this GEMM workload.
caveats: Attention benchmarks and Blackwell paths are not dense-projection H200 evidence.

name: reference-kernels
relevance: Official credit identifies judge-format ancestry; license identified only, no candidate reuse.
upstream_claim: Not an optimized-winner leaderboard or evidence of H200 speed.
caveats: Restricted license; no implementation reuse. Mixed architectures/tasks.

name: kernelbot
relevance: Official credit identifies harness ancestry; license identified only, no candidate reuse.
caveats: Restricted license; no implementation reuse. Not a kernel competitor ranking.
